text:
jess (releases): deploy-bot skipped the staging publish for `service-x:staging-20260321` — says "ambiguous platform tag" in the provenance check. can someone look?

deploy-bot: [system] Publish skipped: manifest list contains multiple matching manifests; provenance signature covers digest `sha256:aaa111` but manifest list points to `sha256:aaa111` and `sha256:bbb222` for different platforms. Policy=reject-ambiguous-platforms.

marta (runtime): ugh, that sounds like the builder pushed a manifestlist that references a prior arm64 image digest (bbb222) but cosign signed only the amd64 digest (aaa111).

samir (infra): quick check — can we `crane manifest` the image from staging mirror to confirm? e.g. `crane manifest us.gcr.io/redwood/service-x:staging-20260321`

leo (sre): i pulled the raw manifest: it literally has two pointers. `platform` entries: amd64 -> sha256:aaa111, arm64 -> sha256:bbb222. cosign attached sig only for aaa111.

jess (releases): how did that happen? the canonical build should have signed the multi-arch manifestlist as a single artifact.

marta (runtime): builder pipeline did per-arch push then `manifest create` but a race meant arm64 push completed earlier and got a different digest. signing step ran against the amd64 digest only.

samir (infra): mitigation options: 1) retag with annotated manifestlist that we sign (best), 2) pin deploy to the amd64 digest (if target infra is amd64 only), or 3) allow deploybot to accept when at least one signed manifest matches configured primary arch (riskier).

jess (releases): customers using staging test both arches so we shouldn't silently drop arm64. prefer retag+resign. can we do that in the next 30m change window?

leo (sre): we can do a manual promote: build a new manifestlist that references the two existing digests but attach a signed provenance that covers the manifestlist itself. Steps:
```
crane manifest create --file manifests.json us.gcr.io/redwood/service-x:staging-20260321
crane push --manifest us.gcr.io/redwood/service-x:staging-20260321
cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KEY us.gcr.io/redwood/service-x:staging-20260321
```
(where `manifests.json` explicitly lists the two digests and platforms)

marta (runtime): i'll prepare the manifests.json and validate with `skopeo inspect` before we sign.

samir (infra): also need to update the release notes to mention the republish and new signed manifestlist digest so QA can point their e2e at the fixed digest if needed.

jess (releases): assign owners: marta prepping manifests, samir on push + cosign, leo to verify deploybot acceptance. i'll coordinate change window 10:40-10:50 UTC.

marta (runtime): starting now, will post `manifests.json` in this thread when ready.

(10m later)
marta (runtime): manifests.json prepared and validated. crating manifest succeeded locally. `crane manifest inspect` shows platform entries and `skopeo inspect --raw` matches.

samir (infra): pushed new manifestlist and signed with cosign. new manifestlist digest: `sha256:ccc333`. pushed to us.gcr.io/redwood/service-x:staging-20260321-resigned

leo (sre): tested deploybot against the new tag — deploybot accepted the manifestlist and provenance check passed. staging canary started.

jess (releases): great. we'll retag the resigned manifestlist back to `staging-20260321` during the change window and add a note to release notes: "republished signed multi-arch manifestlist (digest sha256:ccc333) to fix ambiguous-platform provenance".

samir (infra): do we want to rotate the builder pipeline to sign the manifestlist instead of per-arch digests? i can make a follow-up ticket.

marta (runtime): yes — follow-up: add atomic manifestlist signing step after manifest creation. tickets/PLAT-3421.

jess (releases): thanks all. leaving this thread open until the retag is complete and release notes updated. :thumbsup:

leo (sre): noted — monitoring logs for any other staging publishes with similar pattern. so far only this one.

deploy-bot: [system] Manual retag detected by human operator — will accept if provenance signature validates against manifestlist digest sha256:ccc333.

jess (releases): retag done, release notes updated, closing thread.

leo (sre): :white_check_mark: closing on my side.
